title: Frontend gives one sentence about the animals' permanent address; Design release 1 warns that a false address is fraud and explains what a permanent address is

finding.frontend: The whole of the frontend's guidance on this question is the single sentence "A permanent address is required for this animal.", set under a small "Permanent address" heading in the middle of the identification card (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/copy/copy.en.js:90-92). It says the address is needed. It does not say what a permanent address is, who will use it, or what happens if the trader invents one.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 puts three things above the question. A warning, in the GOV.UK warning-text component with its exclamation icon: "Providing a false address is an act of fraud". Then a definition, as a lead-in and two bullets: "A permanent address is where an animal:" — "will permanently reside" and "can be checked by the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA)". Then the question itself as a heading, "Where will their permanent address be?" (app/views/permanent-address-animals.html:37-64). The second bullet is the reason the address matters, and it is the part the frontend never tells anybody.
finding.difference: Replace the single sentence with Design release 1's three blocks: a govukWarningText carrying "Providing a false address is an act of fraud", the two-bullet definition naming APHA, and the question "Where will their permanent address be?". The copy lives in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/copy/copy.en.js:90-92 with a Welsh sibling to match. No new data and no new field.
finding.falsifiedBy: Any mention of fraud, of permanent residence, or of the Animal and Plant Health Agency in the frontend's rendered identification page. The captured DOM of fe-animal-identification contains none of the three words "fraud", "reside" or "APHA".
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier: a case-insensitive grep for fraud, reside or APHA over capture/html/frontend/fe-animal-identification.html returns nothing, and the only guidance in the block is the one sentence at :232. Read the Design release 1 DOM at capture/html/prototype/dr1-permanent-address-animals.html:249-269 and confirmed the warning-text component with its exclamation icon, the lead-in and the two bullets, then the h2 question at :278. Opened the Design release 1 page shot and confirmed all four blocks render as described and in that order. Checked app/views/permanent-address-animals.html:37-64 is a root view and that the range does contain the warning at :37-40, the guidance at :42-48 and the question at :63. CORRECT.
finding.correction: The claim stands and the falsifier does not fire. One thing the finding leaves out, recorded here rather than added to the slot because it belongs with a different increment: Design release 1 also hints its "Enter a new address" option with "This is where they will stay after spending 48 hours at the place of destination." (app/views/permanent-address-animals.html:82-94 via the radio items built at app/routes.js:2496-2500), which is a further sentence of guidance Frontend does not carry. It sits on the radio rather than above the question, so it travels with identification--permanent-address-same-as-destination-choice, which is the finding that introduces that radio.
